notes.page_content: The writer replaces a cancelled proposal to proceed by induction on card K with “On note d’abord que.” The sheet writes V as X minus the union of the hatted positive Sigma terms and adds an intersection of negative Sigma terms underneath. It records the nonempty intersections involving the closure of V and the negative Sigma side, with “alors que” before the empty positive-side intersection.
notes.main_assertion: The writer explicitly writes bar V cap E_alpha = closure(Sigma_alpha minus) cap E_alpha and adds “qui est donc ≠∅.” The two smaller formulas below remain locally qualified as live/cancelled insertions because the frame line meets their bases.
notes.abandoned_argument: The cancelled material attempts the reverse inclusion with x and a neighbourhood W. It then tries to view the formula/relationship as an equality in a space whose old variable remains Y/Z/X. The later live restart names the two closed disjoint parts Y and Z and writes the final closure/intersection equality, followed by “ce qui est immédiat.” These are the manuscript’s assertions, not verified results supplied by this reading.
notes.authors_own_uncertainty: No explicit manuscript question, doubt phrase or question mark was identified on this page. The qualifiers in the proposed source are editorial ink/state qualifications. The words “trivial” and “ce qui est immédiat” are the author’s own assertions.
notes.counts_title_date: The manuscript has card K but no evaluated numerical count, title or date on this sheet. The archive pencil numeral is 21 and appears only in a comment.
notes.mathematics_led_decisions: No mathematical correspondence was used to resolve ink. The unbarred V in the cancelled Comme line is retained; the existing closure bars are preserved locally. S’s broad proposal did not supply any additional bar. No proof check was performed.

The final closure formula uses ordinary display delimiters. Labels retain insertion/deletion annotations invisibly, with actual strokes drawn once.
The marginal trivial is a physical label in the complete figure beside its actual arrow; it is inventoried as a margin note, avoiding an extra detached marginpar copy.
Several initially planned crops clipped a contextual long descender at a boundary; each actual limit is disclosed in provenance. No decided target was recropped.
